evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Quinton frames rehearsal as the condition that makes a rollback real, appealing to security/stability (conservation) and capability/readiness (competence).
Cadence established as a recurring practice appeals to security and stability through regular preparedness.
Assigning ownership for the rehearsal practice reinforces accountability that sustains the security/stability the practice serves.

mints.name: RehearsedReadinessAsPossession
mints.title: a capability not rehearsed is a capability not actually had
mints.frame: Is the value here entering as the gap between nominal and rehearsed readiness, framed as possession versus its absence?
